First Strike ready but separate proc reported outside target packet; compare inactive.

Compare one legal item swap at a time, separating setup damage, rune/item procs and ordinary attack. Rune reasoning: Tryndamere — 100-Fury Bloodlust heal: AP or adaptive stats enter the native heal/shield helper. Gathering Storm is fixed at minute 30; Absolute Focus is selected only above 70% owner HP. Revitalize is tested on the actual recipient rather than assuming low owner HP means low ally HP. Ability basis: Q5 with100Fury is70+0.3AP+100*(2.3+0.012AP)=300+1.5AP. Mana-free AP and Visage amplify unusually large self-heal ratio. Deathcap/Zhonya/Banshee/Lich Bane supply mana-freeAP; Riftmaker converts finite bonusHP intoAP. Visage amplifies received self-healing25%; L Summon Aery: Aery damage/shield is a separate packet; do not fold it into native ability capacity or damage. Nimbus Cloak: Summoner-triggered movement utility; not a free damage or stat buff. Transcendence: Haste/recast utility; no free cooldown refund or extra hit in a fixed action budget. Gathering Storm: Fixed minute-30 adaptive stats (or the authored time), never an infinite-time ceiling. Conditioning: Minute-12 armor/MR; direct only for matching resistance scaling, otherwise survival utility. Revitalize: Native eligible heal/shield modifier; low-HP bonus follows the actual recipient, not automatically the caster.

Rune preparation: Recipient is self. Revitalize bonus below 40% is conditional on that recipient at application; do not silently grant it at full HP. Aery/Guardian/Font heals or shields remain separate from the named ability. Gathering Storm fixed at authored minute 30; no extra game time.

Rune comparison: Compare a real 12-stack Conqueror page with Revitalize at the same recipient state, and AP versus HP shards if missing-health caps limit effective recovery. Extra combat preparation must be logged separately.

Stat shards: Offense adaptive force feeds only the actual AD/AP coefficient and uses real adaptive-type conversion. Flex adaptive force targets the stated AD/AP coefficient. Defense scaling health is 180 HP at level 18, rather than the old 65-HP shard.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

builds.name: Spinning Slash: AD and AP physical burst
builds.summary: Investigate high one Spinning Slash impact output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Spinning Slash impact output under a finite setup; compare controlled item swaps rather than claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: E deals 80/120/160/200/240 + 1.0 bonus AD + 0.8 AP physical. AP is therefore an unusual direct damage route, but magic penetration does not improve the spin. Critical attacks reduce its cooldown; that rule does not mean the spin itself uses an ordinary attack critical multiplier.

Do not consume Fury through Q healing. Riftmaker legally pre-ramped; score one E on one champion.

No extra attacks are added to the scored action budget.
